subject: Kickoff: DualDICE for off-policy evaluation
body:
Hi Bruno, Halima,

Kicking off DualDICE adoption. Why it matters: teams keep wanting to evaluate a new policy from logged data where we don't know the behavior policy that generated the logs. DualDICE from our open-source release estimates discounted stationary distribution corrections behavior-agnostically — no behavior-policy knowledge needed — which is exactly the situation our logged partner-interaction data is in.

Product goal: an off-policy evaluation module in the trust-theory toolkit with confidence-caveated estimates, validated first on tabular and non-tabular GridWalk (the release's reference environments), then on one internal logged dataset.

Milestones on the short window: GridWalk validation by March 13, internal-data pilot by April 10, toolkit module and handoff note by April 27. Productionization would be a Q2/Q3 follow-on, which we should staff-plan for now.

Bruno — staffing next please.

Ximena
